The chart showed Aanya Singh (I-A) as having left the school in two subjects and validated in another, which is impossible. Purvika Singh, who has left and is therefore absent from the current ERP roster, had been bound to Aanya on the shared surname alone, overwriting Aanya's own record. The same fault put four Class VI girls onto one classmate and four boys onto another, and read 'Artha Kumari' as 'Sarthak Chaudhary'. Separately, two admission numbers had been transcribed wrongly: Kartik Aryan was carrying Kanishk Kushan's number and Rishav was carrying Reyansh Kumar's. Twenty-two students were also shown in the wrong section. All corrected: identity is now resolved by admission number first, a shared surname is never accepted, section and roll are taken from the ERP rather than from the sheet, and the build refuses to run if an admission number contradicts the name it sits beside.
